# HireAIVoice

> HireAIVoice is the AI voice service offered under HonorElevate. It handles after-hours and overflow calls, captures requests and callback details, and helps a business assign the next step. It is for local service businesses with recurring phone inquiries, a defined service area, and someone responsible for follow-up, including businesses in Santa Clarita and Los Angeles County. The AI receptionist follows approved hours, services, and routing rules. Confirmed booking requires a connected calendar that has passed testing. To try it, [Call Betty, our AI receptionist: (661) 219-7299](tel:+16612197299), then [Book a 20-minute call with Connor](https://bookwithhonor.com/?utm_source=hireaivoice&utm_medium=site&utm_campaign=llms).
